tagline: A Serene, Nature-Oriented Stay in Pune
about: liv.inn is a modern boutique hotel in Pune. Every room features nature-oriented views, modern amenities, and 24/7 guest support.

facilities.title: Pet-Friendly
facilities.description: Pets welcome at no extra charge

offers.title: Extended Stay Discount
offers.description: Special rates for stays of 7 nights or more. Contact reception for details.

offers.title: Corporate Rate
offers.description: Exclusive rates for business travellers and corporate bookings.

policies.title: Check-in / Check-out
policies.content: Check-in: 11:00 AM | Check-out: 10:00 AM. Front desk is open 24 hours.

policies.title: ID Requirement
policies.content: Valid government-issued photo ID required for all adult guests at check-in.

policies.title: Couple & Family Friendly
policies.content: We welcome couples, families, and solo travellers.

policies.title: Smoking Policy
policies.content: 100% smoke-free property. Smoking is strictly prohibited indoors.

policies.title: Pet Policy
policies.content: Pets are welcome to stay at no additional charge.

policies.title: Payment Methods
policies.content: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Cash, Credit/Debit Cards, Bank Transfer.

policies.title: Extra Bed
policies.content: Complimentary extra bed available upon request (subject to advance notice).

policies.title: Quiet Hours
policies.content: Please maintain quiet after 10:00 PM for the comfort of all guests.

policies.title: Cancellation
policies.content: Cancellation policies vary by booking channel. Please confirm at the time of reservation.

feedback.title: Guest Feedback
feedback.description: We value your experience. Share your feedback to help us improve.
